title: Lipid Quantification
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the provided fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (.json) to upload if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware as specified by the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette; consult support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the protocol.
